title: Inner Child Healing Journal
subtitle: A Journey of Self-Discovery and Healing

sections.title: Welcome to Your Healing Journey
content: This journal is a safe space for you to connect with your inner child - the part of you that holds your earliest memories, emotions, and experiences.
Through journaling, art therapy, and mindful coloring, you'll explore:
• Creative expression as a healing tool
2. Allow yourself to feel without judgment
3. Use the prompts as guides, not rules
5. Be gentle and patient with yourself

sections.title: Hand Tracing Exercise
sections.subtitle: Grounding & Body Awareness
sections.instruction: Trace your hand on this page. On each finger, write something you're grateful for today.
sections.purpose: This simple exercise helps you ground in the present moment and connect with your physical body.

sections.title: Mindful Coloring
sections.subtitle: Thankful, Grateful, Blessed
sections.instruction: Color this page mindfully. Notice the colors you choose and how they make you feel.

sections.title: Transformation Coloring
sections.subtitle: Butterfly of Change
sections.instruction: As you color this butterfly, reflect on the transformations you're experiencing in your healing journey.

sections.title: Growth & Nurturing
sections.subtitle: Flower Garden
sections.instruction: Each flower represents a quality you're nurturing within yourself. Color them with care.

sections.title: Meeting Your Inner Child
prompts: What did you love to do as a child?
What made you feel safe and happy?
What did you need but didn't receive?
What would your younger self want to hear from you today?

sections.title: Emotional Awareness
prompts: What emotions am I feeling today?
Where do I feel these emotions in my body?
What is my inner child trying to tell me?
How can I nurture myself today?

sections.title: Self-Compassion Practice
prompts: What would I say to comfort a hurting child?
How can I offer that same compassion to myself?
What does my inner child need to feel loved?
What small act of kindness can I give myself today?

sections.title: Letting Go & Forgiveness
prompts: What am I ready to release?
What no longer serves my growth?
Who or what do I need to forgive (including myself)?
What does healing look like for me?

sections.title: Free Expression
sections.instruction: Use these pages to write, draw, or express yourself in any way that feels right.

sections.title: Your Healing Continues
content: • Healing is not linear - there will be ups and downs
• Every step you take matters, no matter how small
• Your inner child deserves love, patience, and compassion
• You are worthy of healing and happiness
You are doing beautiful, important work. Keep going. 💜
